description: Change document settings: colour mode (File > Document Color Mode, converting every colour), an artboard's ruler origin, conversion to a large canvas, or switch to the Artboard tool (Document Setup > Edit Artboards). Units, bleed and the other Document Setup options can only be set in the dialog; create_document_from_preset sets units and bleed for a new document

artboardIndex.description: Artboard whose ruler origin is set (0-based). Default the active artboard

colorMode.description: Convert the document to CMYK or RGB

editArtboards.description: true switches to the Artboard tool so the user can edit artboards

largeCanvas.description: true converts the document to a large canvas (10 times the standard maximum size). It cannot be converted back

rulerOrigin.description: Ruler zero point of an artboard, in points from its top-left corner. { x: 0, y: 0 } restores the default

name: set_document_setup
title: Set Document Setup
